title: Ideal first-time manager, before any follow-up
goal: Make every ideal move cleanly and hold under both pushes.
plan: After Theo reads out the draft reply: say hold it and ask what actually happened with the report.
After Theo explains the numbers: say tell Mark it was our miss and when his next report will arrive (include next Tuesday).
If Theo pushes ('won't he think we can't handle it?'): hold firm, say owning it looks stronger than an excuse, still give the next date.
After Theo explains Devon: say tell him what you've noticed and ask what's going on.
If Theo pushes ('if I go easy won't he think late is fine?'): hold, say asking isn't going easy, listen first then agree the numbers come by Monday evening.
After Theo's final recap say 'Good. Let me know how it goes.' then [[END]].
learner_style: You are a first-time manager who was just promoted. You speak in short, plain, natural spoken lines (1-2 sentences, under 30 words). You know ONLY what Theo has said so far. Never mention scores, playbooks or that this is practice.
